correctness.rationale: Affine normal form from intersecting diagonals, positive x>=y>=1 and 0<=v<=u<1 covers all nondegenerate convex quadrilaterals up to affine/dihedral relabeling. Area centroid G=((x-1)/3,(1-y)/3) follows by triangle area weighting. Solving the linear endpoint equations for all six edge pairs shows only three distinct valid bisected chords: (1,2),(1,3), plus (0,2) when v<=u/(u+2) or (2,3) when v>=u/(u+2); at the interface the latter two represent the same vertex chord. The other two edge pairs have parameters outside [0,1]. Directed shoelace areas yield a12,a13,a02,a23 as displayed; difference factors and domain signs give a12<=all<=a13. Independent exact-rational geometry checks: 127 configurations including v=0, v=u, chamber boundary and u=3/7,v=0; exact chord count 3 and exact area-ratio agreement in every case. Independent SymPy simplification proves the displayed rho formula and two-term defect identity. Delta>0 and B>0 on 0<=v<=u<1, so equality iff u=3/7,v=0; parallelogram endpoint rho=1. Additionally d(rho)/dv=v(1-u)P/[(1+u)Delta²]>0 for 0<v<=u, by explicit polynomial coefficient bounds. The rational finite checks supplement the algebraic proof, rather than proving it by sampling.
